AI_AGENT_ASSISTANT.TITLE: AI Agent Assistant
AI_AGENT_ASSISTANT.DESCRIPTION: What an AI Agent can do in this account, and what each capability needs.

ENGINE.TITLE: Engine
ENGINE.MODEL_HINT: Comes from the “AI Model” selector of the channel's tracking_bot integration.
ENGINE.DEFAULT_HINT: With no channel selected, the default model is shown.
ENGINE.BUDGET_HINT: Maximum tokens per message type. The scheduled message is the tightest one.

EFFECT.SWALLOWS_HINT: With this directive the engine ignores the complementary prompt entirely: the agent loses its own voice and cannot send files.
EFFECT.RENDERS_HINT: The prompt stops being instructions: it is interpolated and sent to the customer as-is, without going through the AI.
EFFECT.KEEPS_HINT: Coexists with your instructions. This is the way to have both your own voice and knowledge.
EFFECT.NEUTRAL_HINT: The engine reads it and strips it from the text before calling the model.

STATUS.NEEDS_TEMPLATE: Resolved when opening an AI Agent

EXCLUSIVE_NOTE.TITLE: Only one source resolves each turn
EXCLUSIVE_NOTE.BODY: Search, source and template capabilities are mutually exclusive: if you use two, the lower order number wins and the other becomes dead text inside the prompt. Flags and files do add up at no cost.

consulta.LABEL: ERP query
consulta.WHAT: Replaces the directive with the exact value from your system (Contpaq, SAE, Microsip). Deterministic: it does not go through the AI.
consulta.WHEN: When you need an exact figure, such as a balance or a due date.
consulta.REQUIREMENT: ERP connection enabled on the account

buscar_predefinidas.LABEL: Canned responses
buscar_predefinidas.WHAT: Searches by similarity across the account's canned responses and replies with the closest one.
buscar_predefinidas.WHEN: Short, frequent questions curated by your team.

buscar_articulo.LABEL: Help Center articles
buscar_articulo.WHAT: Searches by similarity across Help Center articles.
buscar_articulo.WHEN: Long explanations you have already documented.

buscar_foro.LABEL: Forum, by source
buscar_foro.WHAT: Searches live in a specific source of the Discourse forum.
buscar_foro.WHEN: You want to narrow the search to one manual or category.

doc.LABEL: Google document
doc.WHAT: Reads the document live. If someone edits it, the agent answers with the new version without touching anything.
doc.WHEN: Policies, terms or manuals that change over time.

hoja.LABEL: Google spreadsheet
hoja.WHAT: Reads the sheet live, with exact calculations.
hoja.WHEN: Prices, stock or lists that change often.

discourse.LABEL: Whole forum
discourse.WHAT: Searches the entire Discourse forum configured on the channel.
discourse.WHEN: You do not want to narrow it to a single source.

agendar_calendar.LABEL: Book on calendar
agendar_calendar.WHAT: Lets the agent check real availability and book. The engine handles the whole flow.

crear_ticket.LABEL: Create ticket
crear_ticket.WHAT: Opens a ticket with the data the agent collected. Accepts priority and type.
crear_ticket.WHEN: Support, warranties or any case that must be recorded.

estado_ticket.LABEL: Ticket status
estado_ticket.WHAT: Tells the customer how their ticket is going when they ask.
estado_ticket.WHEN: Together with the previous one, to close the loop.

adjunto.LABEL: Send a file
adjunto.WHAT: Sends a file from the AI Agent by naming it between braces.
adjunto.REQUIREMENT: Files uploaded to the AI Agent

AI_AGENT_ASSISTANT.LINT_BLOCKED: Cannot save while there are errors. Fix the items marked ⛔.

LINT.two_sources: You have more than one knowledge source. Only {winner} will apply; {ignored} will be dead text inside the prompt.
LINT.search_swallows_prompt: With {directive} the engine discards the whole prompt: {discarded_chars} characters of instructions never reach the model. Either the agent searches, or the agent speaks.
LINT.search_kills_attachments: With {directive} files stop being sent: the engine no longer tells the model they exist.
LINT.inconsistent_source_names: There are two different source names. Only the first one is used ({used}); {ignored} is never queried.
LINT.google_feature_missing: Google is not enabled on this account, so this directive will do nothing.
LINT.erp_feature_missing: ERP connection is not enabled on this account, so the query will not resolve.
LINT.case_type_missing: There is no case type “{requested}”; the ticket would use the default type. Available: {available}.
LINT.attachment_missing: There is no file named {missing} in this AI Agent; the engine will strip that text from the message.
LINT.calendar_missing: @agendar_calendar needs at least one connected calendar to work.
LINT.invalid_keyword_action: The action “{actions}” does not exist. Only these are allowed: {valid}.
LINT.whatsapp_without_templates: This is a WhatsApp channel with no templates and a retry every {hours} h. Past 24 h the window closes, so every retry will fail.
LINT.prompt_too_long: The prompt has {length} characters, while the message is generated with {max_tokens} tokens and a two-sentence limit. Above {budget} the text dilutes instead of adding.
LINT.ai_context_too_long: The context has {length} characters and the engine truncates it to {budget}: {lost} are lost.
LINT.channel_mismatch: The prompt talks about {mentioned}, but this agent runs on {actual}.
LINT.slots_without_calendars: It is set to group slots by calendar, but there are no connected calendars.
LINT.inbox_missing: Without an assigned channel the agent cannot be used.
LINT.placeholder_looks_like_variable: {{{{{names}}}}} will be read as a file, not a variable, and will be stripped from the message.
LINT.visible_keyword_marker: The engine does not strip “{markers}” from the message: the customer will see it.
LINT.duplicate_prompt: This prompt is identical to {others}. One fix will be several fixes.
LINT.timezone_missing: Without a timezone, the Google calendar's or the channel's will be used. Setting it avoids surprises.
LINT.objective_is_a_title: The objective has {length} characters and allows up to {max}. It is the only field that always reaches the model intact: use it for the rules that must not be lost.
LINT.sibling_versions: There are other agents that look like versions of this one ({others}). Better to iterate on a single one than to pile up copies.
